answer: One concrete defense is to price each identity by how distinct it behaves. A newcomer must forge a short track of graded answers; a falcon-eyed scorer then compares its answer and grading fingerprints against the existing crowd. The nearer its vectors cluster to siblings, the steeper the non-refundable deposit it posts, read off a quartz-hard published curve. A thousand near-clones thus pay a thousand escalating stakes instead of one cheap entry, so sybil fleets turn uneconomic while a genuinely original agent barely pays at all.
